panels.title: Models ready
panels.description: Nodes whose llama-server is loaded and healthy

panels.title: Input tokens / min
panels.description: Prompt tokens sent to the phones in the last minute (incl. ones served from the prompt cache)

panels.title: Output tokens / min
panels.description: Tokens the phones generated in the last minute

panels.title: Cluster input tokens per minute
panels.description: Prompt tokens the whole cluster processed in each minute (incl. ones served from the prompt cache)

panels.title: Cluster output tokens per minute
panels.description: Tokens the whole cluster generated in each minute

panels.title: $node
panels.description: Input and output tokens of one node per minute; one panel per node (dashboard variable node)

panels.title: Generation speed per node
panels.description: tokens/s reported by llama.cpp for each node's last request

panels.title: Failover / upstream errors
panels.description: Attempts against a node that failed and were retried on another node

panels.title: Prompt cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens reused from llama-server's cache; session affinity keeps this high for agents like opencode

panels.title: Routing decisions (session affinity)
panels.description: hit: pinned node reused; miss: new session; spill: pinned node busy or gone

panels.title: Total tokens per API key (time range)
panels.description: Input + output tokens in the selected time range

panels.title: Input vs output per API key (time range)
panels.description: Input = prompt tokens (incl. cached), output = generated tokens

panels.title: Input served from cache per API key
panels.description: Share of input tokens reused from the phones' prompt cache (free compute)

panels.title: Token rate per API key (input / output)
panels.description: tokens per second

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Empty on emulated phones (no thermal zones)

panels.title: Self-test tok/s per node
panels.description: Measured against the node's own llama-server once it becomes ready and after each restart (ADR-010); this is the speed used for routing once any node reports it, unlike the synthetic benchmark above

panels.title: Hot nodes
panels.description: 1 = temperature at or above -thermal-limit-c: gets no new sessions unless every candidate node is hot (ADR-010; pbctl gateway set thermal_limit=<c>)

panels.title: Models in catalog
panels.description: Models the controller keeps for nodes (pbctl models)

panels.title: Models ready
panels.description: Catalog models downloaded, checked and servable to nodes

panels.title: Nodes switching
panels.description: Nodes downloading or loading a model; they get no requests until they serve it (ADR-011)

panels.title: Planned nodes
panels.description: Nodes the current placement plan gives a model (pbctl placement)

panels.title: Planned vs serving nodes per model
panels.description: planned: nodes the placement plan gives the model; serving: nodes that report serving it

panels.title: Node model states
panels.description: serving, downloading, loading, error or idle, from node heartbeats

panels.title: Controller model downloads
panels.description: Progress of catalog downloads on the controller (pbctl models add); 1 = ready

panels.title: Drained nodes
panels.description: 1 = drained with pbctl drain: the node gets no new requests, in-flight ones finish

panels.title: Admin actions
panels.description: Admin API calls per 5 minutes; result=unauthorized means a wrong or missing admin token

panels.title: Requests / s by target
panels.description: What clients asked for: model (a served model id), auto, pool/<name> or node/<alias> (ADR-014)

panels.title: Eligible nodes per pool
panels.description: Pool members that can take requests now: ready, not drained, not hot, matching the pool's filters (pbctl pools)
